description: 6-character geohash of the IBB cell (~0.92 km x 0.61 km)
Start of the hourly interval, Europe/Istanbul (UTC+3)
Stadium the cell is assigned to (RAMS, SARACOGLU, TUPRAS)
Geohash ring around the stadium cell: R0 (k=0), R1 (k=1), R2 (k=2), DISTAL (k=5)
Cell centre coordinates (decoded geohash)
Hourly speeds in the cell (km/h), IBB
Distinct observed vehicles (relative intensity, not volume) and log(1+x)
Hour without a valid observation (not imputed); system-wide outage hour
<5 vehicles; outside Q1-1.5 IQR / Q3+1.5 IQR of the cell hour-of-week; the limits
Cell has >=80 % hourly coverage; only these cells are analysed
Calendar features
Official Turkish holiday; religious-holiday eve or 28 October
Open-Meteo ERA5 hourly weather at the stadium
Precipitation >=0.1 mm/h and >=2.5 mm/h
Match in the +/-6 h span, hour relative to rounded kick-off, pre/during/post/other/none
Match at this stadium on this date; match at any of the three stadiums
Match attributes from the TFF fixture
Crowd proxy and season (main or closed-doors placebo)
z-score standardisation of speed and min-max normalisation of vehicles within each cell
Temperature in 5 equal-width bins; vehicles in 5 equal-frequency bins
Dummy variables of the event window
Cell free-flow speed (85th pct, 01-04 h, non-match days) and avg_speed / ff_speed
free (>=0.75), moderate (0.50-0.75), congested (<0.50) of speed_ratio
z-score of speed vs the cell hour-of-week mean and SD < -2
